read_bridge_existing_packet: lookup : UnionFind.findRoot r before.core.representatives target = some found
root_packet: rootPath : UnionFind.Reaches before.core.representatives target target rootSize
read_identification: findRoot_correct lookup gives the found path; reaches_unique with the genuine target root gives found.representative=target; Frame.values transports oldStored to read.values[target].
nil_identification: Compare the actual nil observation with incomingRun, infer replacement=.empty, and use encoded plus encodeNode.empty to identify handle=0. Use afterSame, readStored and the existing cacheRun directly.
singleton_identification: Compare the one actual success row with incomingRun to identify the actual core with after.core; afterStored gives its pending target payload.
cache_comparison: Keep cacheRun exactly as Option.map (frame after.core) (NativeIndex.write ... (frame read before)) = some after. frame discards input core and is not injective, so map_inj_right is not available for that function.
before_pending_alternative: before PendingAt plus Frame.values supplies an existential pending pair in read. It does not identify that pair with the returned oldNode/oldScs without the actual root/getter link. The direct getter inversion already uses only genuine inputs.
